system_description.narrative_title: Global bond market rout and surging long-term yields
system_description.narrative_summary: A coordinated surge in long-term government bond yields — driven by persistent inflation pressures, central-bank tightening expectations, and rising oil prices — is rippling through financial markets. The sell-off is exposing fragilities in related credit markets (private credit/private equity), pressuring equities and emerging markets, and redirecting flows into commodities like gold, while policy decisions and macro data (jobs, CPI) act as ongoing catalysts.
system_description.scope: The open system includes global fixed-income markets (sovereign and corporate bonds), central-bank policy signals and interest-rate expectations, inflation drivers (notably oil), investor flows and risk appetite, and near-term interactions with equities, private credit/private equity, and commodities (especially gold) over a weeks-to-months horizon.
system_description.super_system: The global financial and macroeconomic system (growth, inflation, cross-border capital flows, and monetary/fiscal policy frameworks).
adjacent_subsystems: Private credit and private equity markets

variables.name: Long-term nominal yields
variables.description: The prevailing market interest rates on long-dated government and similarly rated fixed-income instruments, measured as a continuous nominal yield level.

variables.name: Headline inflation rate
variables.description: The ongoing percentage change in a broad consumer price aggregate over a rolling period, capturing current inflationary pressure in the economy.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: The market and public anticipations of future inflation expressed as a continuous expectation level derived from surveys and market-implied metrics.

variables.name: Policy rate expectations
variables.description: The continuously varying market-implied expectation of future central policy interest rates over different horizons.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: The spot or benchmark price level of crude oil, measured continuously as an index or currency-denominated price.

variables.name: Term premium on long rates
variables.description: The extra yield investors demand for holding long-dated bonds versus rolling short-term instruments, measured as a continuous premium component of yields.

variables.name: Yield curve slope
variables.description: The difference between longer- and shorter-maturity yields, measured continuously to capture curve steepness or inversion dynamics.

variables.name: Fixed-income market liquidity
variables.description: The prevailing ease and tightness of trading in fixed-income markets, measured by bid-ask spreads, market depth and transaction costs on a continuous scale.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: The net movement of investment capital across jurisdictions into and out of financial assets, measured as a continuous flow rate.

variables.name: Investor risk appetite
variables.description: The aggregate propensity of investors to accept risk in portfolios, measured continuously through allocation tilts and risk premia indicators.

variables.name: Private credit spread
variables.description: The yield premium demanded on privately originated credit instruments relative to a comparable risk-free benchmark, measured continuously.

variables.name: Equity valuation pressure
variables.description: The continuous tendencies for equity prices to compress or expand relative to fundamentals, proxied by price-to-earnings, earnings yields and market-implied returns.

variables.name: Emerging market financial stress
variables.description: The continuous degree of currency, bond and equity market strain in emerging economies, measured by exchange rate moves, yields and volatility.

variables.name: Safe-haven asset flows
variables.description: The rate at which capital is reallocated into traditionally defensive assets (e.g., precious metals, high-quality debt), measured as a continuous inflow/outflow metric.

variables.name: Leverage in non-bank credit
variables.description: The aggregate leverage ratio within non-bank credit intermediation (including private credit and shadow banking), measured as a continuous stock-like ratio.

variables.name: Labor market tightness
variables.description: The continuous balance between labor demand and supply, measured by vacancy-to-unemployment ratios and related wage-pressure indicators.

catalysts.title: Fed's main PCE inflation release
catalysts.description: Release of the Fed's preferred inflation gauge (PCE) that markets expect to move inflation and rate expectations. Immediate reaction could push long yields and policy pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'The Fed's main inflation measure will be released Wednesday. Here's what to expect' (2026-09-29).

catalysts.title: US jobs report (upcoming)
catalysts.description: Monthly US employment report that can sharply reprice growth and Fed-hike expectations, likely influencing 10y/30y Treasury yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Why the upcoming jobs report could send 10-year and 30-year Treasury yields surging' and 'jobs data looms' (2026-09-27/29).

catalysts.title: Market re-pricing for an October Fed hike
catalysts.description: Ongoing market repricing that increases odds of a Fed rate rise in October, shifting short-rate expectations and yield curves during October.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Dollar Rises to 2-Month High on Growing Prospect of October U.S. Rate-Rise' (2026-09-29).

catalysts.title: Near-term oil price rise
catalysts.description: Continued upward oil pressure from geopolitical and demand factors that feeds into inflation and government bond yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Oil price rise puts more pressure on government bonds', 'Bond sell-off deepens and oil rises...' and 'oil price and US Treasury yields in tightest relationship since 1990' (2026-09-27/29/28).

catalysts.title: Easing private credit withdrawals
catalysts.description: Slowing investor redemptions from private credit funds that could ease spreads and non-bank liquidity stress if sustained.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Private credit turmoil eases as investor withdrawals slow' and related private credit coverage (2026-09-27/28).

catalysts.title: Surge in repo borrowing / short-term funding demand
catalysts.description: Elevated repo borrowing indicates rising short-term funding demand that can tighten liquidity and pressure yields if persistent.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Who is driving the massive surge in repo borrowing?' (2026-09-29).

catalysts.title: Stalled US‑Iran talks / geopolitical flare-up
catalysts.description: Deterioration in US‑Iran negotiations that lifts oil prices and safe-haven flows, affecting yields and EM stress.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Bond sell-off deepens and oil rises as Iran-US deal hopes fade' and 'U.S. Treasury Yields Rise as U.S.-Iran Talks Stall' (2026-09-28/29).

catalysts.title: RBA's further tightening path

catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Australia’s central bank raises cash rate to 15-year high' and 'more hikes not off the table' (2026-09-29).
